blurb: Guests board at Shem Creek in Mount Pleasant, SC, and sail Charleston Harbor on a 55-foot catamaran or a 40-foot pontoon boat. Cruises offer views of historic landmarks like Fort Sumter, the Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge, and the USS Yorktown. Options include public sunset cruises, private charters, and event hosting for weddings, reunions, and parties.

quotes.author: Janet Siano
quotes.text: From sunny weather to wind and rain, we had it all! Despite the change of weather and getting very wet, we had a fantastic time! The crew was awesome! They turned up the music and we danced and sang in the rain. We saw choppy water, windy skies and pouring rain and everyone laughed and had fun on the Palmetto Breeze! We got to see the sun set and the Harvest moon at the same time! It was a wonderful evening!

quotes.author: Madeline Steele
quotes.text: We had so much fun! This was my first time going and it lived up to the hype! I brought my family, we had a blast. Thank you Justin, Austin and Sunshine for an unforgettable evening on the Palmetto Breeze!

quotes.author: Kourtney Bowman
quotes.text: We did a sunset cruise with Justin and Sunshine tonight and it was great. Their hospitality was so welcoming. The boat was clean and comfortable. Thanks for such a great night!

quotes.author: Kathleen Hoffman
quotes.text: What a great experience! Beautiful weather, drinks flowing, fun music, great scenery and spectacular sunset. Highly recommend to everyone!

quotes.author: Lindsay Kischko
quotes.text: Sunshine, Jesse and Justin may be the best crew I've ever had the pleasure of sailing with!! These gems are keepers! Great experience!

quotes.author: Katherine McInnes
quotes.text: The BEST way to get out on the water in Charleston. Fun, knowledgeable crew dedicated to showing their guests a good time.
